title: Plan AA: AI Animated Short Film
summary: Story script → character design → storyboard → image/video generation → assembly & music
scenario: For a 1-3 minute stylized animated short, handling characters, visuals and music with AI end to end.

steps.title: Story script
steps.detail: Write a short story with a single through-line, a three-act shape and a clear emotional arc; in 1-3 minutes there's room for one turn, and no more than three main characters.
steps.tips: Start with one sentence — 'what the hero wants, what blocks them, how it resolves' — then expand; don't jump straight to long prose.

steps.title: Character design
steps.detail: Generate multi-angle reference sheets for the main characters, lock hair, outfit, palette and style into a single description, and reuse it as the fixed reference for every later image-to-video pass.
steps.tips: Reusing one character image as the fixed reference gives you the most stable cross-shot consistency.

steps.title: Storyboard
steps.detail: Turn the script into a storyboard table: shot number, visual, dialogue, duration and camera move, marking keyframes and emotional beats. Budget roughly one shot per 3-5 seconds — around 15-20 shots per minute.
steps.tips: If you can't draw, write detailed visual descriptions and let the AI turn them into image prompts.

steps.title: Image / video generation
steps.detail: Generate keyframes in Flux first, then animate them with image-to-video in Kling or Runway; produce a few takes for important actions and transitions and pick the best. You can also render characters and backgrounds separately and composite.
steps.tips: Generating characters and backgrounds separately keeps the style unified and lets you swap backgrounds without redrawing characters.

steps.title: Assembly & music
steps.detail: Cut shots to the storyboard, time transitions and score to the emotional beats, generate an ending theme or ambient track in Suno, then grade, caption and add sound effects.
steps.tips: Lock the music before editing — the edit flows far better when emotional beats follow the track.

pitfalls.title: Character inconsistency
pitfalls.detail: Looks or outfits changing between shots is the #1 AI animation pain point — lock the reference.

pitfalls.title: Too many, too short shots
pitfalls.detail: 30+ shots in 1-3 minutes is unwatchable; learn to leave breathing room.

pitfalls.title: Chasing 3D realism
pitfalls.detail: AI 3D characters collapse easily; stylized 2D is far more stable.

pitfalls.title: No sound design
pitfalls.detail: Visuals without sound feel dry; add ambient audio and foley.
